label: The six steps
subgoals: Map the request to the smallest safe change
Build incrementally and run golden and QoR tests
Return failures as feedback or show passing diffs for review

label: Who does what
subgoals: Limit the model to proposing text
Give the harness every file write, build and test run
Reserve acceptance for a human reviewer

label: Termination and escalation
subgoals: Set an attempt and wall-time budget per request
Escalate edits that leave the declared tier
